echoParts: For the promise is for you
and for all who are far off
verseText: You will receive the gift of the Holy Spirit. For the promise is for you and for your children and for all who are far off...
meaning: The Holy Spirit is God's gift to his people. His promise is for all who believe: young and old, near and far.
